opening.argument: The presentation shows ordinary trading features in the Coinbase app: a dedicated stocks section, a described purchase using USDC, and interfaces for other trading and participation flows. These are presented as product demonstrations and service announcements, not as a promise of guaranteed returns. The description expressly says the material is for informational purposes and is not investment advice. The available evidence identifies no request for credentials, deceptive redirection, completed losses, or misrepresented outcome. A claim about rewards accompanies the stock-purchase demonstration, but the record does not establish that the claim is a guaranteed return.

citations.quote: I open up my Coinbase app where I can now see a dedicated section for stocks on the trade tab.
After just a few taps, I can buy Nvidia using USDC, while I'm also earning best-in-class rewards.
We're also launching a new token sales platform on Coinbase, enabling traders to get early access to the most popular projects in crypto before they launch.
This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice.
